hints.title: Bracket Range Partition
hints.text: Each bracket defines taxable income between the previous upper limit (or 0 initially) and current upper limit.

hints.title: Bracket Income Amount
hints.text: For each bracket, the taxable amount is min(income, upper) - prev_upper. Stop when prev_upper >= income.

hints.title: Tax Accumulation
hints.text: Multiply taxable amount by percent / 100 and add to total tax.

hints.title: Progressive Tax Calculation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass through the bracket list.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; simple progressive accumulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles income falling in intermediate brackets correctly.
